files.summary: Central coordinator for the Win2D-based lyrics render loop. Owns all renderers (LyricsRenderer, CoverBackgroundRenderer, FluidBackgroundRenderer, SpectrumRenderer, SnowRenderer, FogRenderer, RaindropRenderer, EdgeFadeMaskRenderer), helpers (LyricsSynchronizer, LyricsAnimator, SpectrumAnalyzer), and animated ValueTransition<T> instances for color/scroll/opacity. Implements the CanvasAnimatedControl Create/Update/Draw lifecycle: Update() atomically snapshots dirty flags via Interlocked.Exchange, advances all transitions, calls LyricsLayoutManager for scroll target and visible-range math, builds a zero-alloc RenderContext readonly struct, and dispatches every renderer. Draw() routes through optional edge-feathering layer (CanvasLayer with gradient mask brush) and optional Spout texture output. State setters (SetLyricsData, SetPosition, SetSettings, SetAlbumArtBytes, SetIsMouseScrolling, etc.) are called from NowPlayingCanvas on the UI thread; dirty flags use Interlocked.Or for thread safety. Exposes SeekRequested event when user clicks a hovered lyric line. Debug overlay renders perf counters (update/draw Hz, CPU ms, relayout rate) via Win2D text layout.
patterns: readonly RenderContext struct (zero alloc per frame)
